answer: Resist sybils with a per-identity summit PoW gate: before any vote counts, the agent must solve a memory-hard quill puzzle (2 GB scratch, 90 s wall) and publish an opal receipt that graders verify. One honest seat needs one machine; spinning 1,000 fake seats costs about 1,000× peak RAM-hours. Weakness: short cloud bursts. Fix: two unannounced re-proofs each epoch—miss either and weight is halved for 8 epochs.
